hero.headline: Bring it filthy. Drive it home
hero.lede: Bay 2 at Foundry Yard. Scroll to run a full six-stage detail on this coupe, from road film at 38 GU to a coated 95 GU finish.

stages.name: Pre-rinse
stages.text: Low-pressure rinse at 40 bar lifts loose grit and road salt before anything touches the paint.

stages.name: Snow foam
stages.text: pH-neutral foam dwells for 5 minutes and softens traffic film, so it slides off instead of scratching.

stages.name: Contact wash
stages.text: Two-bucket wash with grit guards, a fresh microfibre mitt per panel, roof first and sills last.

stages.name: Decontam
stages.text: Iron remover reacts with embedded brake dust and bleeds purple. A clay pass lifts whatever is left.

stages.name: Polish
stages.text: Dual-action machine polish levels swirls and holograms. We measure clear coat before and after.

stages.name: Ceramic
stages.text: An SiO₂ coating bonds to the clear coat. Water beads at 110° and rolls off a 10° slope.

correction.title: Swirls out. Clarity back.
correction.body: Swirl marks are fine scratches, usually 1–3 µm deep in a clear coat that is 35–50 µm thick. We level them with a dual-action polisher and measure film build on every panel, so we only remove what the defect needs.

defects.name: Swirl marks
defects.text: Circular scratches from car-wash brushes and dirty mitts. They show as a spider web around any point light.

defects.name: Holograms
defects.text: Buffer trails left by a rotary polisher used badly. Refined out with a finishing pad.

defects.name: RIDS
defects.text: Random isolated deep scratches. We tell you before polishing if one needs wet sanding.

defects.name: Water-spot etching
defects.text: Mineral rings baked into the clear coat by sun on hard water.

correction.caption: Driver's door under a 6,500 K hex LED panel. Drag across the panel to compare.

packages.title: Price it before you book.
packages.body: Pick your vehicle size and how far you want to go. Prices include VAT. Hours are labour time in the bay for one detailer.

items.name: Maintenance wash
items.desc: Foam, two-bucket wash, wheels, glass, spray sealant top-up.

items.name: Gloss enhancement
items.desc: Full decontam and a one-step polish. Removes 50–70% of swirls.

items.name: Correction + 2-year ceramic
items.desc: Cut and refine to 80%+ defect removal, then a 2-year SiO₂ coat.

items.name: Full correction + 5-year ceramic
items.desc: Multi-step correction to 90%+, 5-year coat on paint, wheels and glass.

coatings.title: Wax, sealant or ceramic, by the numbers.
coatings.body: Tilt the test panel. Water leaves the surface once the slope passes the product's sliding angle, which is why a coated car dries itself on the drive home.

booking.title: Book a drop-off.
booking.body: Pick a day and a slot. We text you when the car goes into the bay and again when it is ready. The 17:30 slot uses the key safe, and work starts next morning.
